title: Limit state
description: Body of an `evidence` artifact: one observation of one window of a resource pool (design/resources.md). Pools and windows are operator configuration, never a hardcoded plan. Every reading field is optional, because sources omit them.

window.description: The configured window observed, e.g. five-hour or seven-day for an interactive plan, monthly for a programmatic credit, minute for an API rate limit.

kind.description: rolling: resets a fixed time after use starts; calendar: resets at fixed dates; credit: a balance drawn down; rate: requests or tokens per interval.

seconds.description: The window's length, when it has one.

state.description: ok: work may draw on it; limited: a limit was hit and it cools down until `cooldownUntil` or `resetsAt`; unknown: no reading says either.

source.description: status-line: the agent CLI's rate_limits; limit-notice: a provider's usage-limit message or error; response-headers: an API's rate-limit headers; runtime-result: a runtime's result message; invoice; history-estimate: computed by code from recorded usage, conservatively.

evidence.description: The artifact or event the reading was taken from, when there is one.
